title: Vanishing module cohomology on all opens implies acyclicity for module-valued sections
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and F an O_S-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose that H^p(V,F|V)=0 [pqf-def-cohomology, lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] for every open V and p>0. Then F is right acyclic [def-sp-acyclic] for the O_S(V)-module-valued sections functor on S.Modules, for every open V.

proof.text: Fix V. Obtain EnoughInjectives on S.Modules and V.toScheme.Modules from [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-modules-enough-injectives]. Apply [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact] to S.toRingedSpace and V. Its finite-limit/colimit preservation gives exact restriction, and its exact left adjoint gives preservation of injectives by [lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives]. Transport these instances across Mathlib overFunctorEquiv V, whose second factor overEquiv V is an equivalence, to restrictFunctor V.ι. From an injective resolution I of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], construct J of F|V with cocomplex R(I), augmentation singleMapHomologicalComplex.inv followed by R(I.ι), and termwise injectivity. Exact functors preserve the augmentation quasi-isomorphism.

Write E for evaluation at V and G for global sections on V.toScheme. Their images of I and J compute the corresponding right derived objects by InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj [def-sp-left-exact-additive], with moduleCohomology as defined in [pqf-def-cohomology]. After forgetting scalar actions, construct an isomorphism of complexes from Mathlib restrictAppIso V.ι at top followed by the presheaf map of the equality V.ι_image_top [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. The differential compatibility is exactly naturality of each differential viewed as a map of abelian presheaves. Forgetful functors from modules to abelian groups preserve homology; use ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso to identify homology of these underlying complexes with underlying groups of module homology.

Apply hcoh V (q+1). Transport the zero object to H^(q+1)(G(J)) by the resolution comparison, then forget to abelian groups. Transfer vanishing across the complex isomorphism and the forgetful homology comparisons. ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton and AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton reflect this vanishing back to H^(q+1)(E(I)). Finally transport along I.isoRightDerivedObj E (q+1); quantify over q and V, which is [def-sp-acyclic].

proof_origin.place: Tag 01E1 (2), proof; Tag 01EX final reformulation. K2: concrete restricted resolution and comparison after forgetting scalar actions, using the existing exact restriction adjunction tool.

lean.statement:
theorem module_sections_acyclic_of_cohomology_vanishing (S : Scheme.{u}) (F : S.Modules)
    (hcoh : ∀ (V : S.Opens) (p : ℕ), 0 < p →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj F))) :
    ∀ V : S.Opens,
      (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} S.ringCatSheaf ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} S.ringCatSheaf.obj (op V)).rightAcyclic F
